import socket,sys
with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",7500),10) as s:
 s.settimeout(None)
 while True:
  data=s.recv(4096)
  if not data: raise SystemExit("Monitor connection closed")
  sys.stdout.buffer.write(data); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
